rationale: Restricted HF automatically reuses the separately charged physical-slot Gram cache at >=512 AOs with history capacity >=2, using the existing scalar-order FP64 reducer. Resource admission, cached-plan invalidation and execution share the guard. Smaller/unrestricted owners retain serial defaults. Explicit 0 rolls back; explicit 1 keeps cooperative or explicitly selected ordered diagnostics. Three alternating complete HF48/96 endpoint rounds and independent original/moved/property/rollback gates qualify the scoped cold gain without changing Fock work, tolerances, arithmetic order or cache size.
revisit_condition: Qualify complete endpoints and independent original/moved forces before widening spin or size admission or changing reduction order. Preserve inactive-control semantics, reset/cache ownership and explicit rollback. The remaining HF96 cold gap is dominated by full Fock work, not Gram reuse.
